desc: Elk season awaits with the Bull Stalker™ Rifle Case from the Gear Fit Pursuit™ line of gun cases by Allen. Purpose-driven and designed so you can bring all your Elk hunting essentials with you, from scent and calls, to binoculars and more. Made with Mossy Oak® Mountain Country™ camo with bright orange accents, the case fits scoped rifles up to 48-inches and features four large pockets designed for what you bring to the hunt. The main front pocket has two rows of organization straps for all your gear. The rear pocket has an adjustable flap closure so you can fit even large accessories in this pocket. The center pouch has a large opening and a drawstring closure to easily fit your scent/cover spray. The inside of the case has heavy-duty, dual-density foam for ultimate protection. The lining is easy clean, and the oversized zippers make it easy to open and close.
